name: Register Rewrite Rule Engine
description: Rule-based register rewriting engine that transforms text between linguistic registers (casual, academic, narrative, technical → direct) using deterministic regex patterns. Zero API calls, sub-millisecond performance.

types.name: RewriteRule

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: Regex pattern to match in source text

fields.name: replacement
fields.description: Replacement string or callable for matched pattern

types.description: Dataclass representing a single regex-based rewrite transformation

types.name: RuleEngine
types.description: Stateless engine that applies register rewrite rules deterministically

functions.name: rewrite
functions.description: Rewrite text from source register to target register using regex-based rules. Returns original text if source equals target or no rules exist. Falls back through 'direct' register if no direct path exists.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Source register (string or enum with .value attribute)

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Target register (string or enum with .value attribute)

preconditions: source and target are either strings or objects with .value attribute
postconditions: Returns original text if source == target
Returns original text if result after all rules is empty string
If no direct (src, tgt) rules exist and tgt != 'direct', attempts (src, 'direct') first

invariants: All rule transformations use case-insensitive regex matching (re.IGNORECASE)
Empty results after rule application fall back to original text
Rules are applied sequentially in list order
Both string replacements and callable replacements use re.sub with same flags
